surfaces.name: Tycho · regional relief
surfaces.description: Crater and surrounding highlands in a source-backed coarse global DEM window.

coordinates.provenance: Window center is an actual DEM node. Named-feature locator: https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Feature/6163; source frame retained without a tie-point transformation.

grid.horizontal_method: Original 0.25-degree source nodes, flattened using spherical meters at window center; coarse regional visualization.

limitations: Coarse regional orbit view from a 0.25-degree global DEM; no metre-scale terrain detail or ground-walking coverage is implied.
Project-selected window around the named feature; the window is not its official boundary or a landing recommendation.
Grid heights preserve exact source nodes; source provider modeling/interpolation remains present.
Flat display uses east-west spacing at the window-center latitude and north-south spherical arc spacing. It is approximate over this broad region, not exact ENU.
USGS feature coordinates are approximate locators; no transformation between the feature control network and source DEM realization is claimed.
